description.message: Send the post you're looking at (text, comments, links, even behind a login) to your own driftnet. Reads Threads, X and Instagram.

cantReadPage.message: This page can't be read (browser or store page).

serverHint.message: Where your driftnet server is reachable from this computer, e.g. http://localhost:8787

permissionDenied.message: Permission to reach this server was not granted.

privacy.message: The extension only reads a tab when you click it or use the right-click menu, and sends what it read to your server only.

httpsRequired.message: Only localhost may use http. Use an https:// address for any other server.

tokenRejected.message: Server rejected the token (HTTP 401) — check it.

unreachableLocal.message: Can't reach driftnet on this computer — start it with npx driftnet in a terminal and keep that window open.

unreachableRemote.message: Can't reach driftnet at $URL$ — is it running, and is the address right?
